title: Active Override Declaration
description: Human-declared override permitting a single write to a forbidden path. Must be created before committing. Consumed and archived by post-commit hook.

declared_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the override was declared

declared_by.description: Who granted the override. Must be 'human' — agents cannot self-grant overrides.

items.description: Exact file path (relative to repo root) covered by this override. No globs — one path per entry.

scope.description: Exact list of forbidden paths this override permits writing to. Must be minimal — no wildcards.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for why this override is needed

expiry.description: Override expires after one commit. Permanent overrides are not permitted.

session_ref.description: Optional reference to the conversation or ticket that authorized this override
